admin.indexnow.title: IndexNow
admin.indexnow.description: Tell Bing, Yandex and other IndexNow search engines about new or changed pages right away instead of waiting for their crawlers.
admin.indexnow.step_key_desc: Paste the key generated in Bing Webmaster Tools →
admin.indexnow.step_verify_desc: The site serves the key at /your-key.txt automatically — search engines read it to confirm you own the site.
admin.indexnow.key_file_bad: Key file is not valid or reachable (HTTP {status}). Check your deployment and try again.
admin.indexnow.step_submit_desc: Submit every page in sitemap.xml, or paste specific URLs (one per line). Resubmit only when pages change.
admin.indexnow.forbidden: You do not have permission to view IndexNow.
admin.indexnow.load_error: Could not load IndexNow settings. Please retry.
admin.indexnow.check_error: Could not check the key file. Please retry.
admin.indexnow.public_site_required: This website is configured with a local or private URL. Set VITE_APP_URL to its deployed public HTTPS address and redeploy before submitting. Local previews can save keys but cannot notify search engines.
